title: Max and the Haunted House in the MPR
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: During the McKinley Harvest Festival, the MPR turns into a haunted house. For weeks, parent volunteers build walls, hang cobwebs, and paint spooky signs. High school students from the robotics team even help build some of the rooms. Max has walked past the MPR door a hundred times, wondering what is inside.

Finally, it is Max's turn. Max holds Lupe's hand, and Kai holds Max's other hand. A volunteer at the door says, "Remember, everything in here is pretend. If you want to come out, just say the word." Max takes a deep breath and steps into the dark.

The first room is full of fog and green lights. A skeleton in a rocking chair creaks back and forth. Then a voice says, "Boo!" and a volunteer in a sheet jumps out. Max jumps so high that Max's ears almost touch the ceiling. Then all three friends start laughing.

The next room is the best one. It looks like the surface of Mars, with red rocks, glowing stars, and a robot that rolls toward them, beeping. "The robotics students made this," Kai whispers. The robot's eyes flash, and it says, "Welcome, Earthlings!"

When they come out the other side, Max's heart is pounding, but Max is grinning. "Was it scary?" asks a first grader waiting in line. Max thinks about it. "A little," Max says. "But the good kind of scary. The kind you do with friends."

quiz.q: What did the best room look like?
quiz.ev: It looks like the surface of Mars

quiz.q: Why did the volunteer remind them everything was pretend?
quiz.ev: Remember, everything in here is pretend.

o: People who help without being paid
